name: Decalogue
overview: The Decalogue, also known as the Words of the Covenant or the Tables of Testimony, is a direct communication from God, establishing His divine authority over His people. As revealed in Exodus 20, God personally spoke these commandments, emphasizing His role as the LORD who delivered Israel from bondage. These laws call for exclusive worship of God alone, forbidding idolatry and demanding obedience, with promises of mercy to those who love and keep His commandments.
